I am a woman of 49 years here in Lilongwe, with only a small piece of land. This little plot of 0.08 hectares I have put to root crops — cassava and sweet potato mostly — because they feed my family even when the rains are poor. I do not waste the fertilizer coupon on roots; if I get FISP this year it goes to my maize plot, not here. For these tubers I will put some manure from the goats and chickens, use the cuttings I saved from last season, and work the ridges myself with the hoe.
